scope: Independent source review and lightweight numerical checks of frozen native-reference guidance

environment.reason_for_no_user_site: Initial import without isolation encountered pre-existing user NumPy/system SciPy incompatibility (numpy.typeDict missing); isolated system packages passed.

ordinary_path_equivalence.method: Load baseline and edited active_arm_mppi.py as separate modules; force both _legacy_native=None; compare guide and full proposals on identical seeded states, references and limits.
ordinary_path_equivalence.coverage: Alternating forward/reverse references, varied state/yaw/velocity/joints, curved paths, and 20 duplicated endpoints inside the historical terminal envelope.

candidate_phase_isolation.method: Generate all six base modes together, then each mode independently from fresh kernels at a frozen 4.5 cm target; compare complete candidate control sequences exactly.

hysteresis_and_resets.source_identity_review: Adapter pause key includes goal stamp, native start/epoch/revision, gear block, explicit gear and frozen phase. New goals/references/cancel/finish alter or remove this identity before navigation resumes; existing revision checks also discard previous commands.

new_regression_suite.coverage: Old 2.5 cm threshold oscillation, configured hysteresis radii, explicit native gear at small/zero scale, candidate independence, identity reset, yaw wrapping, closed-loop recovery, collision/lease rejection, legacy numeric outputs and adapter propagation.

source_review.shared_guidance: Both guide and proposals use _base_guide; frozen guidance uses the same position/yaw and explicit native gear. Each candidate owns its horizon align array; only measured-state setup updates persistent stage.
source_review.standby_compatibility: Adapter only supplies tracking keyword for active navigation; standby subclass retains its previous call signature and implementation.
source_review.parameter_consistency: Node reads existing controller base_tracking_resume_distance and applies the same slow-distance/resume clamp as MMControllerFSM.
source_review.safety_path: Physical speed cap remains before maneuver scale; advance/evaluate, configuration bounds, collision and braking checks, node base_command/checked_first_step, fresh-map checks and planning/delivery deadlines are unchanged by this diff.
source_review.scope_control: No changes to controller thresholds, ROS messages, deployed native libraries or hardware state in the reviewed production diff.

limitations: Offline checks establish software behavior, not real-vehicle convergence or safety validation.
Numerical equivalence and candidate independence checks use the NumPy integrator; deployment libraries are outside this change and were not modified.

A frozen pose outside the resume envelope with a large yaw error may require more than 20 seconds under the existing angular/linear limits; closed-loop run duration must be distinguished from a stalled algorithm.
